description: Korean income tax reduction for young employees of SMEs (조특법 제30조): 15-34 at contract (military service up to 6 years subtracted), 90% of earned-income tax, capped at 2M KRW per year, for the months through 5 years after starting. Computes year-end tax with and without the reduction (social insurance estimated from salary), the end month and a 5-year estimate. The 2026 tax reform proposal to lengthen the period outside the capital region from 2027 is not applied.
name: calculate_kr_sme_youth_tax_reduction
title: calculate kr sme youth tax reduction
